question: How should the deity be worshipped after completing the prescribed visualization?
premises: The deity has been visualized thus
Worship is performed on the seat
The deity is endowed with limbs and enclosures
inference: After thus meditating, one should worship the deity on the seat together with limbs and enclosures.
plain_english: Having meditated thus, one should worship him on the seat, endowed with his limbs and surrounding enclosures.
